# Shooter Archetypes

This section summarizes the clustering analysis of NBA **shooters** using k-means, PCA, and Gaussian Mixture Models.

## Data Preparation

```{r shooter-data}
# Load data
shoot_adv <- read.csv("data/ad.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
shoot_per100 <- read.csv("data/pos.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
shoot_shot <- read.csv("data/shot.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

clean_duplicates <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(Player) %>%
    filter(n() == 1 | Team == "2TM") %>%
    ungroup()
}

shoot_adv <- clean_duplicates(shoot_adv)
shoot_per100 <- clean_duplicates(shoot_per100)
shoot_shot <- clean_duplicates(shoot_shot)

merged <- shoot_adv %>%
  inner_join(shoot_per100, by = c("Player", "Pos", "Age", "Team", "G")) %>%
  inner_join(shoot_shot, by = c("Player", "Pos", "Age", "Team", "G"))

shoot_data <- merged %>%
  filter(as.numeric(MP.x) >= 500) %>%
  select(
    Player,
    USG. = USG.,
    FGA_per100 = FGA,
    AST_per100 = AST,
    Dist = Dist.,
    X3PAr = X3PAr,
    pct_FGA_0_3 = X0.3,
    pct_FGA_3_10 = X3.10,
    pct_FGA_10_16 = X10.16,
    fg_pct_0_3 = X0.3.1,
    fg_pct_3_10 = X3.10.1,
    fg_pct_mid = X10.16.1,
    fg_pct_long_mid = X16.3P.1,
    fg_pct_3P = X3P.1,
    pct_3PA_Corner = X.3PA,
    pct_FGA_Dunks = X.FGA,
    pct_Ast_2P = X2P.2,
    pct_Ast_3P = X3P.2
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(-Player, as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

scaled_shoot <- scale(shoot_data[, -1])
```

## Elbow Method (K-Means)

```{r shooter-elbow}
# Elbow and derivative plots
set.seed(222)
MAX_K <- 10
sse <- map_dbl(1:MAX_K, ~ kmeans(scaled_shoot, centers = .x, nstart = 22, iter.max = 20)$tot.withinss)

p1 <- tibble(K = 1:MAX_K, SSE = sse) %>%
  ggplot(aes(K, SSE)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(color = "#1f78b4", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method for Shooter Archetypes", x = "Number of clusters (K)", y = "Total within-cluster SSE") +
  theme_minimal()

p2 <- tibble(K = 1:(MAX_K-1), SSE_diff = sse[1:(MAX_K-1)] - sse[2:MAX_K]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(K, SSE_diff)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(color = "#e31a1c", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "SSE Rolling Difference", x = "K", y = "SSE Difference") +
  theme_minimal()

p3 <- tibble(K = 1:(MAX_K-2), SSE_2nd = sse[1:(MAX_K-2)] - 2*sse[2:(MAX_K-1)] + sse[3:MAX_K]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(K, SSE_2nd)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(color = "#e31a1c", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "SSE Rolling 2nd Difference", x = "K", y = "SSE 2nd Difference") +
  theme_minimal()

p1 + p2 + p3
```

## Final Shooter Clusters (K = 5)

```{r shooter-kmeans}
set.seed(222)
km_shoot <- kmeans(scaled_shoot, centers = 5, nstart = 25)
shoot_data$Shooter_Cluster <- factor(km_shoot$cluster)

cluster_profiles <- shoot_data %>%
  group_by(Shooter_Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Avg_USG = round(mean(USG.), 1),
    Avg_FGA = round(mean(FGA_per100), 1),
    Avg_AST = round(mean(AST_per100), 1),
    Avg_Dist = round(mean(Dist), 1),
    Avg_3PAr = round(mean(X3PAr), 2),
    Avg_0_3 = round(mean(pct_FGA_0_3), 3),
    Avg_Mid = round(mean(pct_FGA_10_16), 3),
    Avg_Dunks = round(mean(pct_FGA_Dunks), 3),
    Avg_Ast2P = round(mean(pct_Ast_2P), 3),
    Avg_Ast3P = round(mean(pct_Ast_3P), 3),
    Avg_FG_Rim = round(mean(fg_pct_0_3, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Avg_FG_3P = round(mean(fg_pct_3P, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  )

knitr::kable(cluster_profiles, caption = "Cluster profiles (shooters)")
```

### Cluster Profiles (Z-scores)

```{r shooter-centers}
feature_names <- c("USG.", "FGA_per100", "AST_per100", "Dist", "X3PAr",
                   "pct_FGA_0_3", "pct_FGA_3_10", "pct_FGA_10_16",
                   "pct_3PA_Corner", "pct_FGA_Dunks", "pct_Ast_2P", "pct_Ast_3P",
                   "fg_pct_0_3", "fg_pct_3_10", "fg_pct_mid", "fg_pct_long_mid", "fg_pct_3P")

km_centers <- as.data.frame(km_shoot$centers)
colnames(km_centers) <- feature_names
km_centers$Cluster <- factor(paste0("Cluster ", seq_len(nrow(km_centers))))

km_centers_long <- km_centers %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Cluster, names_to = "feature", values_to = "z_val")

km_centers_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = feature, y = z_val, color = Cluster, group = Cluster)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Cluster, ncol = 3, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "K-Means Cluster Centers (Z-scores)", x = "Feature", y = "Z-score")
```

### Spider/Radar Plot (Cluster Profiles)

```{r shooter-radar}
# Radar plot requires scaling all features to [0,1] so they can be compared on the same radial axis.
radar_scaled <- km_centers_long %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(z_scaled = (z_val - min(z_val)) / (max(z_val) - min(z_val))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Close each polygon by repeating the first feature at the end for each cluster.
radar_closed <- radar_scaled %>%
  group_by(Cluster) %>%
  arrange(Cluster, feature) %>%
  mutate(feature = factor(feature, levels = unique(feature))) %>%
  bind_rows(., slice(., 1)) %>%
  ungroup()

radar_closed %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = feature, y = z_scaled, group = Cluster, fill = Cluster, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_polygon(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  coord_polar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "Spider Plot (Radar) of Shooter Cluster Profiles",
       y = "Scaled (0–1) Feature Strength",
       x = NULL)
```

### Cluster Center Heatmap

```{r shooter-heatmap}
km_centers_long %>%
  mutate(Cluster = fct_rev(Cluster)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = feature, y = Cluster, fill = z_val)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b", midpoint = 0) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8)) +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Shooter Cluster Centers (Z-scores)", x = "Feature", y = "Cluster")
```


### PCA Summary

```{r shooter-pca}
pca_shoot <- prcomp(scaled_shoot)
pca_summary <- summary(pca_shoot)

pca_var <- tibble(
  PC = seq_along(pca_summary$importance[2, ]),
  Variance = pca_summary$importance[2, ]
)

pca_var %>%
  ggplot(aes(PC, Variance)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(color = "#e31a1c", size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Variance Explained by Principal Components", x = "Principal Component", y = "% of Variance") +
  theme_minimal()

```

### PCA Scatter (PC1 vs PC2)

```{r shooter-pca-scatter}
pc1_var <- round(pca_summary$importance[2, 1] * 100, 1)
pc2_var <- round(pca_summary$importance[2, 2] * 100, 1)

pc_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_shoot$x[, 1:2])
pc_scores$Cluster <- shoot_data$Shooter_Cluster

pc_scores %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 1.8) +
  geom_rug(alpha = 0.2) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.66) +
  scale_color_npg() +
  labs(title = "Shooter Clusters in PCA Space",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", pc1_var, "% variance)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", pc2_var, "% variance)")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Defender Archetypes

This section summarizes the clustering analysis of NBA **defenders** using k-means and PCA.

## Data Preparation

```{r defender-data}
# Load defender tracking data
def_data <- read.csv("data/defensive_tracking.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Select columns for clustering
def_stats <- def_data %>%
  select(D_FGA_OVERALL, FGA_LT_06_6FT, FG3A_3P,
         PCT_PLUSMINUS_OVERALL, PLUSMINUS_6FT, PLUSMINUS_3P) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))

scaled_def <- scale(def_stats)
```

## Elbow Method (K-Means)

```{r defender-elbow}
set.seed(222)
MAX_K <- 10
sse_def <- map_dbl(1:MAX_K, ~ kmeans(scaled_def, centers = .x, nstart = 22, iter.max = 20)$tot.withinss)

p1d <- tibble(K = 1:MAX_K, SSE = sse_def) %>%
  ggplot(aes(K, SSE)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(color = "#1f78b4", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Elbow Method for Defender Archetypes", x = "Number of clusters (K)", y = "Total within-cluster SSE") +
  theme_minimal()

p2d <- tibble(K = 1:(MAX_K-1), SSE_diff = sse_def[1:(MAX_K-1)] - sse_def[2:MAX_K]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(K, SSE_diff)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(color = "#e31a1c", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "SSE Rolling Difference", x = "K", y = "SSE Difference") +
  theme_minimal()

p3d <- tibble(K = 1:(MAX_K-2), SSE_2nd = sse_def[1:(MAX_K-2)] - 2*sse_def[2:(MAX_K-1)] + sse_def[3:MAX_K]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(K, SSE_2nd)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2c3e50") +
  geom_point(color = "#e31a1c", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "SSE Rolling 2nd Difference", x = "K", y = "SSE 2nd Difference") +
  theme_minimal()

p1d + p2d + p3d
```

## Final Defender Clusters (K = 5)

```{r defender-kmeans}
set.seed(222)
km_def <- kmeans(scaled_def, centers = 5, nstart = 25)
def_data$Defender_Cluster <- factor(km_def$cluster)

def_profiles <- def_data %>%
  group_by(Defender_Cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    Count = n(),
    Avg_Contests = round(mean(D_FGA_OVERALL), 1),
    Avg_Rim_Contests = round(mean(FGA_LT_06_6FT), 1),
    Avg_3P_Contests = round(mean(FG3A_3P), 1),
    Avg_Impact = round(mean(PCT_PLUSMINUS_OVERALL), 3),
    Avg_Rim_Impact = round(mean(PLUSMINUS_6FT), 3),
    Avg_3P_Impact = round(mean(PLUSMINUS_3P), 3)
  )

knitr::kable(def_profiles, caption = "Cluster profiles (defenders)")
```

### Spider/Radar Plot (Defender Profiles)

```{r defender-radar}
# Build cluster-center table for defender features

colnames(def_centers) <- c("D_FGA_OVERALL", "FGA_LT_06_6FT", "FG3A_3P",

def_centers$Cluster <- factor(paste0("Cluster ", seq_len(nrow(def_centers))))

def_centers_long <- def_centers %>%

radar_def_scaled <- def_centers_long %>%

radar_def_closed <- radar_def_scaled %>%

  coord_polar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7), legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(title = "Spider Plot (Radar) of Defender Cluster Profiles",
       y = "Scaled (0–1) Feature Strength",
       x = NULL)
```
